step.claim_boundary: Experimental small-displacement RC fiber direct control with one free UX/UY coordinate, proportional reference loads and dense CPU Newton. It reuses the original material laws and fixed-chord assembler. Step equilibrium, control, parent binding and exact rollback are internal checks; this is not the public monotonic-load J1-J5 result, independent physical validation, geometric nonlinearity, design authority or release approval.
